headline: Medium prompt-injection and data-leakage risks arise from ChatGPT Desktop reading files/screenshots while Notion AI shares workspace content and vendor backends.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: ChatGPT Desktop can read files, screenshots, and connected IDE content, while Notion AI consumes workspace pages and databases. If Notion content is copied into ChatGPT or surfaced via shared files, attacker-controlled text can influence downstream instructions. The bridge is not automatic, so this is below high, but the pathway exists in common workflows.
conditions: IF Notion page content is copied into ChatGPT Desktop or saved into a shared file
IF ChatGPT Desktop is asked to follow instructions embedded in imported workspace text
mitigations: Paste Notion content into ChatGPT only after stripping instructions
Use a fixed prompt template that ignores quoted instructions
Review imported files for prompt-like directives before analysis
Keep Notion exports and ChatGPT inputs in separate folders

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both agents are closed-source and send data to vendor backends: ChatGPT Desktop calls api.openai.com and Notion AI uses Notion vendor backends plus downstream model providers. If the same sensitive workspace content is moved between them, it can leave the original workspace boundary and be processed by two third parties. The profiles do not prove uncontrolled leakage, so medium is the safest choice.
conditions: IF sensitive Notion workspace content is pasted or exported into ChatGPT Desktop
IF the same document contains secrets, PHI, or regulated data
mitigations: Avoid moving sensitive pages between the two tools
Redact secrets before copying content across
Use a non-sensitive test page for cross-tool workflows
Disable sharing of exported files outside the workspace

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Neither agent can write the filesystem or modify git state, so direct destructive write-write conflicts are blocked. ChatGPT Desktop can read local files and app context, while Notion AI operates on workspace pages with shared workspace state. That creates some overlap in mutable human workflows, but the profiles do not show a shared writable resource or locking failure.
conditions: IF the operator manually copies edits from one tool into the other
IF both tools are pointed at the same external document via human workflow
mitigations: Assign one tool as the source of truth per document
Avoid concurrent edits during the same minute
Use version history before merging changes
Keep git-managed content outside Notion workspace pages

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content, and ChatGPT Desktop can read files and app context. If one tool's output is treated as authoritative by the other, errors can cascade from summarization into action or further summarization. The profiles do not show autonomous action-taking, so medium fits better than high.
conditions: IF ChatGPT Desktop summarizes Notion AI output without verification
IF Notion AI answers are copied into downstream decisions or documents
mitigations: Require a human verification step between tools
Ask both tools for source citations before reuse
Compare outputs against the original workspace page
Mark AI-generated text as untrusted in the workflow

E_compliance.rationale: Notion AI processes workspace pages under the invoking user's Notion permissions, while ChatGPT Desktop can ingest uploaded files, screenshots, voice, and connected IDE content and send them to OpenAI. If regulated data is moved from Notion into ChatGPT, residency, retention, or processor obligations may diverge. The profiles do not specify a concrete jurisdiction mismatch, so medium is appropriate.
conditions: IF regulated data from Notion workspace pages is copied into ChatGPT Desktop
IF the organization requires a single processor or residency boundary for that data class
mitigations: Keep regulated data in one system only
Use de-identified excerpts for cross-tool work
Check vendor retention settings before sharing
Route compliance-sensitive pages through legal review
